name: Bussel Realty Corp (New Brunswick office)
what_they_do: Commercial real estate brokerage specialising in industrial, warehouse, office, retail and investment property across New Jersey, with tenant and landlord representation. The 'New Brunswick NJ' pages are service-area landing pages; the only office address published anywhere on the site is 2 Ethel Road, Suite 202A, Edison NJ.
customers: Industrial and office tenants, landlords, developers and investors across Central/North Jersey; also government and institutional occupiers.

size_signals.signal: Employee directory lists 25 broker emails with direct mobile numbers (Steve Bussel SIOR, Gregory Irving SIOR and others)
Separate site sections per property type (industrial, office, warehouse, investment, retail) and a property-search system
Dun & Bradstreet estimates 25-99 employees across all sites (third-party estimate)

listing.platform: No Google Business Profile or map listing verified

website_review.primary_cta: 'Search Inventory' / 'What Is Your Property Worth?' and a property-search box; phone number in the header
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No enquiry form and no booking - the 'Contact' page is a broker directory plus a CRM login; all contact is by phone or individual broker email
website_review.trust_signals: Twenty-five named brokers with SIOR designations, 20+ years in the market, property inventory and press/news sections - strong for the category
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Home page contains hidden injected spam: a div positioned at left:-9999px with Vietnamese, Hebrew/Portuguese and Russian gambling and passport text linking to vietnam-millionaire.me, portuguese-passport.online and top10binary.ru - a classic hacked-site SEO injection. The stack is classic ASP (.asp URLs) and /contact-us/ returns a raw IIS 404 page exposing server paths (C:\www\bussel\contact-us\).
website_review.search_basics: Titles follow 'Real Estate Broker <Type> - <Place> NJ' which is workable, but there is no schema markup at all (0 JSON-LD blocks), no meta-description-driven landing pages, and the injected spam will actively damage rankings
top_issues: Site is compromised: hidden spam links in three languages on the home page
Raw IIS error pages leaking filesystem paths; /contact-us/ 404s
No structured data anywhere and no tel: links, so phone numbers are not clickable
No web enquiry path for a prospective tenant or landlord - only a CRM login form on the contact page

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is a permissive classic-ASP file (blocks admin/login paths only), so nothing is deliberately blocked. But there is zero schema markup, phone numbers are plain text, there is no service-area text on the New Brunswick page beyond the Edison office address, and the hacked spam injection makes the site a poor citation source. No form or booking exists for an agent to act on.

operations_signals.signal: Property enquiries route to 25 individual broker mobiles with no central form or CRM-facing intake, so leads are hand-dispatched (inference from the directory-only contact page)
Listing inventory is managed through a classic ASP property search, and there is no online tour or requirement-submission path
The compromised home page has been live long enough for a third-party directory crawl to pick up the spam, suggesting no routine site monitoring

top_opportunities.opportunity: Incident response on the hacked site: remove the injected hidden spam block and outbound links, then add monitoring - this is a security and rankings emergency, not a nice-to-have
top_opportunities.evidence: Hidden div at left:-9999px with Vietnamese/Hebrew/Russian spam linking to vietnam-millionaire.me, portuguese-passport.online and top10binary.ru

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace raw IIS errors with real 404/contact pages, add tel: links, and publish LocalBusiness/RealEstateAgent JSON-LD with the Edison address and service areas so agents can answer and route enquiries
top_opportunities.evidence: /contact-us/ returns 'IIS 10.0 Detailed Error - 404.0' with the physical path shown; no JSON-LD; phone is plain text

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a structured requirement/enquiry form (property type, size, location, budget, timeline) that routes to the right broker - replacing 'call the office or email a broker'
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page offers only an employee directory and a username/password login form

scores.reasons: Gap: compromised site with spam injection, no schema, no click-to-call, no enquiry form, raw server errors - every layer is broken. Ability to pay: 25-broker commercial brokerage with big industrial commissions, clearly able to fund a project. Ease: classic ASP and a hack cleanup need a real developer, so slower than a WordPress fix. Evidence: opened the home, New Brunswick, contact and search pages and inspected the DOM for the injection.

wrong_claims.claim: Listing: 'No Google Business Profile or map listing verified' - rating unknown, reviews unknown
wrong_claims.what_is_true: A Google Maps profile does exist: 'Bussel Realty Corporation', 4.5, at 2 Ethel Rd #202a, Edison NJ 08817 ('Located in: Durham Center'), open to 4 PM, linking bussel.com and (732) 287-3777, with an 'Add a photo' prompt and no review count shown in the panel view.

wrong_claims.claim: Name/location framing 'Bussel Realty Corp (New Brunswick office)'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: This is the right company but not a New Brunswick business: the only address published on the site is 2 Ethel Road, Suite 202A, Edison NJ 08817, and the New Brunswick pages are service-area landing pages titled 'Office Property, New Brunswick NJ' for a broker directory. There is no New Brunswick office to visit.
